Name: Hold to Pause
Author: samspartan
Description:
[size=6][b]Hold to Pause
[/b]
[/size]Adds the ability to pause multiplayer games by holding a key or controller button. 

[b][size=3]Default Values:
[/size][/b]Keyboard: [b]P[/b]
Controller: [b]Start[/b]
Delay: [b]2 seconds
[/b]
note: use the key/button names at [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings#Controller]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings#Controller[/url] for modifying the config.

Was made because pausing with controller is way too annoying.

Manifest.Name: HoldToPause
Manifest.Description: Pause multiplayer games with by holding 'P' or 'Start' for 2 seconds
